name: core-runtime-string-encoding-rewrite-depth

evidence.notes: CSV quoting is asserted exactly and round-tripped.
Escaped CSV is decoded back to the exact source.
Slash escaping is asserted exactly and round-tripped.
Escaped ECMAScript text is decoded exactly.
HTML3 entity escaping is asserted exactly.
HTML3 entities are decoded back to exact text.
Java quote escaping is asserted exactly and round-tripped.
Escaped Java text is decoded exactly.
Non-ASCII Unicode escaping is asserted exactly.
Unicode escape text decodes to the original value.
Regex replacement changes every matching token.
Regex replacement changes only the first matching token.
Repeated literal removal is asserted exactly.
Nondefault bounded overlay indexes are asserted exactly.

args: String csv='a,"b",c'; String escapedCsv=csv.escapeCsv(); System.assertEquals('"a,""b"",c"',escapedCsv); System.assertEquals(csv,escapedCsv.unescapeCsv()); String slash='a/b'; String escapedSlash=slash.escapeEcmaScript(); System.assertEquals('a\/b',escapedSlash); System.assertEquals(slash,escapedSlash.unescapeEcmaScript()); String html='<tag attr=''x''>&'; String escapedHtml=html.escapeHtml3(); System.assertEquals('<tag attr='x'>&',escapedHtml); System.assertEquals(html,escapedHtml.unescapeHtml3()); String quoted='He said "hi"'; String escapedQuoted=quoted.escapeJava(); String expectedQuoted='He said '+String.fromCharArray(new List<Integer>{92,34})+'hi'+String.fromCharArray(new List<Integer>{92,34}); System.assertEquals(expectedQuoted,escapedQuoted); System.assertEquals(quoted,escapedQuoted.unescapeJava()); String upperOmega=String.fromCharArray(new List<Integer>{937}); String omega='A'+upperOmega; String expectedEscapedOmega='A'+String.fromCharArray(new List<Integer>{92})+'u03A9'; String escapedOmega=omega.escapeUnicode(); System.assertEquals(expectedEscapedOmega,escapedOmega); System.assertEquals(omega,escapedOmega.unescapeUnicode()); String tokens='a1 a2'; System.assertEquals('X X',tokens.replaceAll('a[0-9]','X')); System.assertEquals('X a2',tokens.replaceFirst('a[0-9]','X')); System.assertEquals('ba','banana'.remove('na')); System.assertEquals('tHE Ω42','The Ω42'.swapCase()); System.assertEquals('abZZef','abcdef'.overlay('ZZ',2,4));

salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves deterministic local String encoding and rewrite behavior with exact nondefault assertions and makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.
